assumptions.statement: The route is bounded and reviewed before simulation.

interfaces.name: route progress
interfaces.failure_behavior: report unknown progress and halt autonomous route

algorithm_plan.choice: fuse bounded motion estimates with map observations
algorithm_plan.rationale: Maintains a measurable pose confidence for route repetition.
algorithm_plan.failure_behavior: halt autonomous route on degraded localization

performance_requirements: report compute, power, and observation freshness
hardware_functional_plan.degradation: halt autonomous route when critical health is unavailable

safety_plan.control_authority: operator and route requests pass through one safety gate
safety_plan.stop_behavior: critical diagnostics and stale requests command zero motion
safety_plan.watchdog: the base interface expires stale requests
safety_plan.fault_recovery: require a documented reset before route continuation

verification_plan.integration: exercise fake diagnostic and base transports
verification_plan.simulation: run the route with degraded localization

open_decisions: Define the operator progress display outside the motion-control boundary.
